preconditions.description: The number of clubs m is between 1 and n, and n is between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= p_i < 5000 for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: Each student's potential p_i is between 0 and 4999.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i <= m for c_i in c)
preconditions.description: Each student's club index c_i is between 1 and m.
The number of days d is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k_i <= n for k_i in k)
preconditions.description: Each student index k_i in k is between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly d values, one for each day.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result[i] < 5000 for i in range(d))
postconditions.description: Each value in the output is a non-negative integer less than 5000.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i] == mex(club_potentials[i]) for i in range(d))
postconditions.description: Each value in the output is the mex of the potentials of the students in the clubs on that day.
